lines.text: The ministry of death, engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Aaron.
The ministry of the Spirit and of righteousness is more glorious than what was fading away, and its glory endures.
Since Paul and those with him have such a hope, they are very bold, unlike Moses, who put a turban over his face.
To this day a veil covers their hearts when Moses is read, but it is taken away whenever anyone turns to the Lord.
Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom, and those with unveiled faces are being transformed into His image.
